title: Go crypto/rsa
notes: Standard-library baseline: sha256.Sum256 of the message, then rsa.SignPKCS1v15(nil, key, crypto.SHA256, digest), which uses the CRT in constant-time arithmetic; returns a 256-byte []byte (base64 through encoding/json for verification). prepare (untimed) parses the PKCS#1 PEM with x509.ParsePKCS1PrivateKey.
